") and verify new parent. - testUnwrap: unwrap a span and verify its children moved up. - testReplaceWith: replace element with another. - testEqualsIdentity: assert same instance equals, different instance not. - testHasSameValue: two separate Elements with same outerHtml considered same. - testCloneDeepCopy: clone element, modify original attribute, ensure clone unchanged. - testShallowClone: shallow clone has no children. - testHtmlAppendable: use StringBuilder and verify html. - testIndent: use protected method via subclass or reflection? indent is protected.
